note: Red on, ten reds open about the baulk half and the middle. The cue ball is down by the bottom-right corner, where every red it can see is long or thin (Amateur reads them all under its safety_below) save one: red 9 beside the brown, cut into the bottom-left corner at a chance of about 0.37 as Amateur reads it. Whatever the pace and spin, a miss of it leaves the other player a red it reads at 8 points or more (test_spec_10_levels_score.cpp checks a grid of strokes), while a safety off red 6 leaves almost nothing.
